hooks.name: Detector tests on save
hooks.description: On save of scanner/detectors/*.py, run the matching detector test file. Read-only: reports pytest results, never modifies files.

action.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0
INPUT=$(cat)
FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | .venv/bin/python3.12 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('filePath') or d.get('file_path') or d.get('path') or d.get('file') or '')" 2>/dev/null) || FILE=''
[ -z "$FILE" ] && FILE='scanner/detectors/ebs_volumes.py'
MODULE=$(basename "$FILE" .py)
.venv/bin/pytest "tests/detectors/test_${MODULE}.py" -v 2>&1 | tail -30
